# Slingshot Transportation

Slingshot Transportation is a Truck Transportation company. Slingshot Transportation Inc. provides logistics solutions, freight management, warehousing & distribution, and value-added services. They have locations in various states and are driven for excellence and powered by people. Slingshot Transportation employs 72 people, founded in 1995. Headquartered in Brooklyn, Michigan, United States, with presence in Canada. Its workforce is distributed across Canada and United States.

## About

At Slingshot Transportation, Inc. our high-performance team of professionals has years of experience and keeps an eye on the future. We understand freight and the best practices surrounding it.

We have the advantages of Freight Leader expertise, company assets, and a proven network of Qualified Associate Carriers. These advantages set the foundation for our commitment of taking responsibility in meeting our customers' needs.

Our team has what it takes to ensure that customer needs are met in a cost-effective and efficient manner.

At Slingshot... We don't just move freight - We lead it!
